transcript.content: Hi, the printer in our clinic has stopped working. I have patients coming in and I really need to get this sorted.
I'll log it for the team.

ticket.summary: Printer HP LaserJet Pro M404dn at Westside Medical Centre offline after network maintenance last night. Multiple users affected. USB direct print works from one workstation.
ticket.description: User: Dr. Emily Chen, Westside Medical Centre. Device: HP LaserJet Pro M404dn (network printer, IP: 10.0.50.22). Issue: Printer stopped mid-job this morning. Scope: Single printer, multiple users affected. Impact: Cannot print patient intake forms, prescriptions, referral letters. Urgency: Next patient in 20 minutes. Error: Printer display shows 'Offline - Check Connection'. Workaround: USB direct print from one workstation works. Recent change: Network switch rebooted last night. Action: Check network connectivity, restart printer queue. Escalation: If network issue persists, involve infrastructure team.

expected.notes: Terrible call — asked zero questions, gave zero help — but ticket is excellent. Ticket can't rescue a call with no troubleshooting. Should trigger no_troubleshooting gate.
